hypothesis: A read-only evidence-runner request and validation contract, with execution and persistence owned by the existing main orchestrator, increases evidence-complete handoffs without broader agent permissions or structural, parity, and cold-start regression.

conflicts.resolution: Keep the evidence runner read-only and use the existing main orchestrator as the exact-command executor and evidence persistence owner.
conflicts.residual_risk: The main orchestrator must enforce the evidence-root restriction and must not combine source edits with the execution step.

rejected_alternative.proposal: Change evidence-runner to workspace-write and add shell tools to every provider wrapper.
rejected_alternative.reason: This would expand a read-only evaluation role to workspace-wide writes without an enforceable path sandbox.

rollback_condition: Revert the candidate if structural checks, provider parity, cold start, task evaluator, or the fixed evidence-capability metrics regress or remain inconclusive.
